legend: The Leones(0,0,0) have finally retired from competition after several years in college and have decided to take a nice vacation at the beach. Although they are a little sad to leave their years of competition in the Grand Prix of Mexico.

They were relaxing in an enramada, ordering some piña coladas and looking at the sea in the distance, when a group of sailboats began to line up on the horizon... it just so happened that the sailboats had numbered sails. After a few minutes the great sage of the Caribbean arrived (also known as the man who sells prepared coconuts) and proposed a riddle in which they would win free coconuts if they solved it correctly. The team could not refuse to do one last problem and they got ready to solve it.

The riddle said the following: Visualize all the sailboats on the horizon as a list of numbers A$$$A$$$ then take an element Ai$$$A_i$$$ and calculate the sum of elements for all possible ranges [l,r]$$$[l, r]$$$ such that Ai$$$A_i $$$ has the maximum value among all elements between Al$$$A_l$$$ and Ar$$$A_r$$$ inclusive.

This riddle was clearly very simple, so after the team answered it correctly, the wise man from the Caribbean decided to make the riddle even more interesting. Now, for the prize of free coconuts for life, the riddle said: let's say that the previous riddle is the result of f(i)$$$ f(i)$$$ for a sailboat at position i$$$i$$$, then solve the sum of f(i)$$$f(i)$$$ for all existing sailboats
This puzzle has exceeded the capabilities of the participants and now they ask for help from the next generations of ICPC
input: In the first line a number n(1≤n≤106)$$$n(1 \leq n \leq 10^6)$$$ the number of sailboats in the sea.
In the second line n$$$n$$$ integers that represents the numbers in the sails of the boats. (−109≤ai≤109)$$$(-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9)$$$
output: The first and only line in the output is the answer to the riddle modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$

legend.ai: Leones(0,0,0) 在大学里参加了数年的竞赛后，终于退出了竞赛，并决定去海滩度过一个愉快的假期。不过，他们对告别自己在墨西哥大奖赛中的多年竞赛生涯感到有些难过。
他们正在凉棚里放松，点着几杯凤梨可乐达，眺望远处的大海，这时一群帆船开始在地平线上排成一列……巧合的是，这些帆船的帆上都印有编号。几分钟后，加勒比海的伟大智者出现了（也就是那位卖特制椰子的人），并提出了一个谜语：如果他们能正确解出谜语，就可以赢得免费的椰子。这个团队无法拒绝再做最后一道题，于是准备解答它。
谜语如下：将地平线上的所有帆船视为一个数字列表 A$$$A$$$，然后取其中一个元素 Ai$$$A_i$$$，计算所有可能的区间 [l,r]$$$[l, r]$$$ 中元素的总和，要求 Ai$$$A_i $$$ 在 Al$$$A_l$$$ 与 Ar$$$A_r$$$(含两端)之间的所有元素中取最大值。
这个谜语显然非常简单，所以团队正确回答后，加勒比海的智者决定让谜语变得更加有趣。现在，为了赢得终身免费的椰子，谜语变成了：假设上一个谜语对于位于 i$$$i$$$ 的帆船所得的结果为 f(i)$$$ f(i)$$$，那么求所有现存帆船的 f(i)$$$f(i)$$$ 之和。
这道题已经超出了参赛者的能力范围，现在他们向 ICPC 的后辈们寻求帮助。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n(1≤n≤106)$$$n(1 \leq n \leq 10^6)$$$，表示海中的帆船数量。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数，表示船帆上的数字。(−109≤ai≤109)$$$(-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9)$$$

output.ai: 输出的第一行且唯一一行是谜题答案对 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$ 取模后的结果。
